summary: Retest of the iteration_117 open items (1-8) plus the regression sweep, on the preview DB with 6,303 products. Backend: 30 tests, 28 pass (test_iter118_retest.py + test_iter117_retest.py). The older suites test_iter114/115/116 give 36 passed and 4 skipped. PASS: (1) Curated blocks now show their products on login, on 3 reloads in a row, and on a reload where the first /products?ids= request is aborted (the retry works). Dead blocks stay hidden. Not met: a cached open sends 2 ids requests, not 1 (see minor). (2) E: rows with sub_category '' and with null fall back to the legacy subcategory (3/3 counted), and the badge matches the list total. (3) F: search equals the regex count for every word tested: test=6003, beauty=546 (the request said 545; the DB regex count is 546), Widget=2, 'PERFTEST Product 00500'=1, Produ=6000, nonsense=0. ix_prod_text_v2 covers all 7 fields and the old ix_prod_text is gone. (4) A: changing or clearing the search sends 1 admin fetch each. Opening the screen sends 1. Taps on page 2, page 3 and prev send 1 fetch each with the right offset. The 15s auto-refresh fires 1 fetch. (6) The single picker has its own search: after searching 'Widget' in the multi picker, the single picker opens with an empty search, '100 shown of 6,303'. Its search works ('PERFTEST Product 00500' gives 1). The multi picker opens in 0.27s. (7) Admin Products is virtualised: 12 cards mounted on open and at most 26 while scrolling the 250-card page. Bulk-select bar, the map sheet (17 shelves, no Recharge), the vendor filter (1 fetch, 6,265) and the pager all work. The vendor dashboard mounts 40 cards at first and grows by 40 while scrolling, up to all 250. Vendor page 2 sends 1 products fetch and 1 ids fetch. (8) The tour does not auto-open on the stocked catalogue, and the ? button opens it. Regression sweep: deep paging in shop search covered 24 pages and 1,440 unique cards with no gaps or repeats, and with_total=false on every follow-up page. Men chips read All 546 / TEST_115_A 75 / TEST_115_B 40 and the server filter gives 75 items (temporary TEST sub-categories, removed afterwards). Curated products are hidden from the plain grid and found by search (Widget gives 2 in the UI). bulk-category rejects Recharge with 400. FAIL: (5) HIGH: vendor and admin interest badges are always 0. The ids call is wired correctly, but the backend list/ids response always returns interested_count=0, because _LIST_PROJECTION drops interested_users before _shape_product counts them. Proof: a product with 2 interested_users returns interested_count 0 from ?ids= but 2 from /products/{id}. NEW (minor-medium): GET /products/subcategory-counts returns 500 when any row in the category has a non-string sub_category (for example the number 123 from an import), because $strLenCP needs a string. No deprecated Expo packages were found (expo-barcode-scanner appears only in a comment in src/barcode-scanner-modal.tsx).

critical.endpoint: GET /api/products?ids=... (and every list path that uses _LIST_PROJECTION)
critical.issue: interested_count is always 0. _LIST_PROJECTION (products_public.py:89-97) excludes interested_users, then _slim_list_item calls _shape_product, which computes len(interested_users or []) = 0. Vendor dashboard and admin 'Interest (page)' badges therefore never show, on any page. Reproduced: product with interested_users=[u1,u2] gives ids -> 0, GET /products/{id} -> 2.

minor.issue: Returns 500 if any matching product has a non-string sub_category or subcategory (for example the number 123): $strLenCP/$trim need strings (products_public.py:508-516). Wrap the fields with $convert to string with onError '' and onNull '', or guard with $type.

integration_issues.issue: The frontend now asks /products?ids=<page ids> correctly, but the backend returns interested_count 0 for everything (see the backend critical issue), so the badges never render.

integration_issues.flow: Shop open with the layout cached
integration_issues.issue: Sends 2 /products?ids= requests, not the 1 claimed. The stale-cache path's request finishes, then .finally clears idsRequest; when onFresh lands (~70ms later) a second identical request fires. Products render correctly both times. Fix: keep the last successful {key, data} in a ref and reuse it while the key matches (clear only on failure or a refreshTick change).

action_items: HIGH: Fix interested_count on list/ids responses. Either keep interested_users in the find and pop it in _shape_product (cost: the arrays), or better, project a computed count with an aggregation $size of $ifNull(interested_users, []) for the ids path, or maintain a stored interested_count field updated with $inc when a shopper taps 'I'm interested'. Then re-check the vendor badge on page 2.
subcategory-counts: make the $group key robust to non-string values ($convert to string with onError '' and onNull '') so one bad imported row can't 500 the whole category's chips.
shop-layout-renderer resolveBlockProducts: cache the last successful ids response per key, so a cached open makes exactly 1 ids request. Today it makes 2; they are harmless but redundant.

admin/products.tsx:459: auto-open the tour only after the first load has finished, with no search or vendor filter (for example loadedOnce && total === 0 && !appliedSearch && !vendorFilter). Today total starts at 0, so on a first visit the tour can flash open during loading, or open when a search returns 0 matches.

Optional: the Shop Layout multi picker hides products used in other blocks, so searching 'Widget' shows an empty list while the footer counts the server total. Show a hint like 'N already placed in other blocks'.
critical_code_review_comments: products_public.py:89-127: the list projection drops interested_users but _shape_product still derives interested_count from it, so every list/ids interested_count is 0 (pre-existing, and now exposed by item 5).
products_public.py:508-516: $strLenCP/$trim on un-typed fields can throw.
shop-layout-renderer.tsx:1174-1177: clearing the shared promise on SUCCESS defeats the dedupe for the stale-cache plus onFresh pair.
admin/products.tsx:109 and 459: total initial state of 0 combined with the 'total === 0' auto-open condition.

vendor/dashboard.tsx:485-490: the growing slice is fine for 250 per page, but it is still a ScrollView, so all 250 cards mount once the user scrolls to the end. That is acceptable at the current page size.
Files over 700 lines: admin/products.tsx (1,296), admin/shop-layout.tsx (2,119), vendor/dashboard.tsx (1,167), src/shop-layout-renderer.tsx (1,683). Consider splitting them.

rca_of_issue: Item 5 badge always 0: dashboard.tsx:117 fetches /products?ids=<page ids>. In products_public.py:270-276 the ids branch calls find(..., _LIST_PROJECTION), which has interested_users: 0, then calls _slim_list_item and _shape_product, which sets interested_count = len(p.get('interested_users') or []) = 0. Repro: insert a product with interested_users ['u1','u2','u3']; GET /api/products?ids=<id> gives interested_count 0, while GET /api/products/<id> gives 3. Mitigation: compute the count server-side without shipping the array (aggregation $size), or store a counter.
